---
description: Update repository documentation after architecture, structure, setup, build, test, or workflow changes.
---

# Update docs

Update repository documentation based on the requested change or current diff.

Relevant files:

```text
README.md
docs/solution-overview.md
docs/project-structure.md
docs/architecture.md
docs/build-and-test.md
.github/copilot-instructions.md
```

---

## Workflow

1. Review the current changes or request.
2. Identify which docs are affected.
3. Update only relevant documentation.
4. Avoid duplicating large sections across files.
5. Keep commands accurate.
6. Keep docs concise and practical.
7. Update related document links when needed.

---

## Update docs when changes affect

- Solution purpose
- Project structure
- Architecture
- Dependency direction
- Build commands
- Test commands
- Run commands
- Deployment/publish steps
- Authentication/authorization
- API communication
- State management
- New dependencies
- Local setup
- Copilot/project conventions

---

## Output summary

Return:

```text
Summary:
- [docs updated]

Validation:
- [links/commands checked or recommended]

Notes:
- [assumptions]
```
